# Andrej Karpathy
AI researcher and educator; co-founder of OpenAI, former Director of AI at Tesla, creator of the LLM Wiki Pattern and the micrograd/nanoGPT teaching series.

## Background

- Co-founder and early researcher at OpenAI
- Director of AI at Tesla (led Autopilot)
- Known for making deep learning accessible through hands-on teaching (nanoGPT, micrograd, karpathy/nn-zero-to-hero)
- Active on X (@karpathy); shares practical AI workflow ideas

## Key ideas

- **LLM Wiki Pattern** — using LLMs to compile and maintain personal knowledge bases over raw source collections. See [[LLM Wiki Pattern]].
- **Incremental Knowledge Accumulation** — query outputs should be filed back into the wiki so knowledge compounds. See [[Incremental Knowledge Accumulation]].
- "Vibe coding" — term he popularized for LLM-assisted programming where you describe intent and iterate on outputs.
- At ~small scale (~100 articles), plain LLM + index files beats RAG for personal knowledge bases.
